item.title: A private Strava setup journey
item.summary: Starting or repairing Strava now uses one durable Connect journey instead of asking you to copy developer credentials into Murph.
item.details: Murph completes Strava application setup through ordinary browser steps, including the application name and read-only callback settings, then captures and seals the client ID and secret without exposing their values to the assistant. Strava may first require a developer subscription or provider prerequisite; when it does, Connect offers Continue in Strava or cancellation before credential capture. Progress remains saved across sign-in, consent, retry, disconnect, and deletion. This release records checked-in workflow and deterministic fake-provider validation; it does not claim external production launch proof.
